title: Everyday Love Calculator: Synergy with a wink
subtitle: Pick small joys, a tiny vice, and today’s mood — get a life-synergy score with witty insights.
seoTitle: Everyday Love Calculator | Life Synergy Score | DailyLogic
seoDescription: The Everyday Love Calculator crosses small joys, habits, and moods into a humorous life-synergy score. Free in your browser.
heroDescription: Life is full of small loves — morning coffee, perfect parking, silence after the kids sleep. This calculator crosses them with your habits and mood to produce a witty synergy score and life insights.

sections.heading: What the Everyday Love Calculator does
paragraphs: Instead of a classic name-based love calculator, this tool explores everyday small loves: food and drink, home moments, odd habits, beloved objects, and lucky moments. You pick what delights you, your tiny vice, and today’s mood — and the engine produces a unique synergy score.

The score isn’t pure chance: it uses trait vectors (energy, comfort, chaos, social, indulgence) plus category and tag intersections. Results come with humorous insights you can refresh again and again.
Everything runs locally in your browser — no signup, and your picks never leave your device.

sections.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Choose what delights you from the category library, add your tiny vice, and mark today’s mood. Hit calculate and enjoy a short “common sense” animation.
After the result, request a new insight or a deeper analysis, share or copy, and optionally save the calculation. Then hop back to the rest of the tools.
Try different combos — each trio tells a different story about how you live the day-to-day.

sections.heading: Why small-love synergy matters
paragraphs: Everyday happiness often comes from tiny moments, not grand events. The tool helps you notice patterns: are you chasing quiet, treats, city luck, or healthy boundaries?
Humor lets you look at habits kindly — without heavy judgment, with a wink of common sense.
Use the result as a conversation with yourself or friends: what actually fills you today, and what looks like a “vice” but is really self-care?

benefits.title: Rich library
benefits.description: Dozens of small loves across real-life categories.

benefits.title: Smart engine
benefits.description: Synergy scored from traits, tags, and mood — not just a lottery.

benefits.title: Rotating insights
benefits.description: Refresh insights and deep dives for more witty gems.

faq.question: Is this a romantic love calculator?
faq.answer: No. It’s for everyday small loves — habits, moments, and moods — with witty insights.

faq.question: Is the score random?
faq.answer: It’s deterministic for your picks, with light hash-based variation — the same combo stays consistent.

faq.question: Is data saved on a server?
faq.answer: No. Picks and saves stay local in your browser.
